derivedFrom.notes: Section order, table columns, rule lines, caption wording, colours and fonts were read out of the two decks. Sample_1.pdf is an older numbered variant; its wording is kept in 'phrasesLegacy' below so the style can be switched without touching code.

meta.unitsLine: Units: Length = mm, Mass = tonnes, Time = second, Force = Newton

materials.note: Allowable is computed as the yield stress divided by FOS, rounded per meta.allowableRounding. Edit the yield stress and the allowable follows.
